title: K01 CONTROL SYSTEM RC1
purpose: Provide one coherent project-control layer over the existing K01 authorities without creating a parallel engineering taxonomy or replacing existing engineering authorities.
principle: SEE EVERYTHING -> DO ONE THING -> CLOSE IT -> REPLAN EVERYTHING -> DO THE NEXT ONE
authority_rule: Generated reports, Center, dashboards, handoff bundles and Git status are projections/evidence. They are never engineering authority by themselves.

planes.project_coverage_plane: All mandatory engineering domains remain visible until CLOSED/RELEASED/explicit NOT_APPLICABLE.
planes.execution_plane: Exactly one active executable engineering workpack. WAITING_EXTERNAL / WAITING_DEPENDENCY / LATER / DEBT do not consume engineering WIP.

hold_contract.rule: A HOLD may stop the active engineering workpack only when blocks_active_workpack=true. CONTROL_SYSTEM_HOLD, CONFIGURATION_HOLD and PROJECTION_HOLD are not automatically ENGINEERING_HOLD.

FAST_CONTROL.when: At session start, before selecting/continuing an engineering workpack, and after a workpack closes.
FAST_CONTROL.behavior: Read-only. No project mutations. No Git staging/cleanup. Produces a current control projection.

DEEP_ASSURANCE.when: Only after control-system code changes, authority promotion, baseline/release promotion, or explicit user request.
DEEP_ASSURANCE.behavior: May run regression/idempotence/configuration checks. Must not displace engineering work indefinitely.

operator_authorities: Approve/change the single active engineering workpack
Approve explicit engineering mutation when required
Accept/reject promotion to a higher authority/maturity/release state
Provide/confirm external evidence and resume triggers
system_responsibilities: Maintain coverage of the full engineering domain registry
Detect duplicate decision identity and conflicting controlled values
Keep parked work and resume triggers visible
Show Git/GitHub state without making unrelated dirt an engineering blocker
Ensure generated projections do not become authority
prohibited_patterns: Treat a generated report or Center as engineering authority
Treat all HOLDs as blockers of the active workpack
Treat a local PASS as product/release PASS
Use git add . or git clean as a normal control workflow
Start a new engineering workpack before the previous executable workpack is closed/parked
Let a control-system debugging loop displace the product indefinitely
